def G(t):
    # Antiderivative of ln(1+t)/t^2, verified by differentiation:
    # d/dt[-ln(1+t)/t + ln(t/(1+t))] = ln(1+t)/t^2
    return -math.log1p(t) / t + math.log(t / (1 + t))
